adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `refreshOAuthTokens` making a `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", body: new URLSearchParams({ calcomUserId, appSlug }) })` with no authentication header/secret (no `headers` at all) in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`. The newly added `.env.example` documents `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` but does not document any shared secret for this outbound sync request (only inbound webhook verification via `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET`/`CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME` is added). This is a concrete, diff-grounded gap, though not necessarily a hard defect since comments indicate the payload is customizable.
